caseNameFull: Walter Leroy MOODY, Jr. v. Cynthia STEWART, Warden.

opinions.text: Application for stay of execution of sentence of death presented to Justice THOMAS and by him referred to the Court denied. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit denied. The order *1591heretofore entered by Justice THOMAS is vacated.
